text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Madison Church Richmond Limited is constructing a 45-storey residential condominium with ground floor retail at 114-120 Church Street and 59 Richmond Street East. The site is located on the west side of Church Street between Lombard Street and Richmond Street East. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to temporarily close a portion of the westbound curb lane on Lombard Street for a period of 25 months, from May 8, 2024 to May 31, 2026 to accommodate a construction staging area. It should be noted that the construction staging area has been installed and is operating under monthly street Occupation permit.
